cues.en: Composite functions are basically when you take one function and stick it inside another function,
cues.zh: 合成函數，基本上就是把一個函數放進另一個，

cues.en: so you're composing one function as the combination of two or more functions.
cues.zh: 用兩個或更多函數組合成一個。

cues.en: This is actually really similar to an idea in coding.
cues.zh: 和程式裡的概念很相似。

cues.en: So having some experience with coding will help you understand composite functions.
cues.zh: 有程式經驗會幫助理解。

cues.en: So what does it mean to compose two functions.
cues.zh: 合成兩個函數，什麼意思？

cues.en: Remember that a function is a set of rules that maps one variable onto another variable.
cues.zh: 函數是一組規則，把一個變數映射到另一個。

cues.en: And we can visualize that abstractly with a diagram that looks like this.
cues.zh: 可以用這種圖抽象呈現。

cues.en: So the function f of x transforms x into y.
cues.zh: f(x) 把 x 轉成 y。

cues.en: Well why just stop at this one function.
cues.zh: 為什麼只停在這個函數？

cues.en: We can take the output of f of x and push that through another function.
cues.zh: 可以把 f(x) 的輸出，再送進另一個函數。

cues.en: Another algorithm, another machine.
cues.zh: 另一個演算法、機器。

cues.en: And we could diagram that like this.
cues.zh: 圖可以這樣畫。

cues.en: So now x is transformed through f into y, and then we apply a second transformation in g of y, which
cues.zh: x 透過 f 變 y，再套第二個變換 g(y)，

cues.en: gives us the final output of Z.
cues.zh: 得到最終輸出 z。

cues.en: So nothing weird here is going on.
cues.zh: 沒什麼奇怪。

cues.en: We're not doing anything bizarre.
cues.zh: 沒做古怪的事。

cues.en: And this is really just a composite function.
cues.zh: 這就是合成函數。

cues.en: So a composite function basically just combines f of x and g of y into a single statement.
cues.zh: 基本上把 f(x)、g(y) 結合成單一敘述。

cues.en: And that looks like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: So basically we just set f of x to be the input into function g.
cues.zh: 把 f(x) 作為 g 的輸入。

cues.en: Now this concept should look familiar from coding because we do this thing all the time.
cues.zh: 程式裡應該很熟悉，經常這樣做。

cues.en: In coding, we use the output of one function as the input into another function, and the order here is also important.
cues.zh: 用一個函數輸出，當另一個的輸入，而且順序重要。

cues.en: This is g of f of x and not f of g of x.
cues.zh: 這是 g(f(x))，不是 f(g(x))。

cues.en: So with whichever function is first is the function that is inside here.
cues.zh: 先做的函數在裡面。

cues.en: So f is applied first and then g is applied after f and well, that's clear from the full diagram here.
cues.zh: 先 f，再 g，完整圖很清楚。

cues.en: In fact, G is not even applied to x, G is applied to y, and y itself is a transformation of x.
cues.zh: 其實 g 不是作用在 x，而是 y，y 本身是 x 的變換。

cues.en: Now this order relates to a property called commutativity of composite functions.
cues.zh: 順序和合成函數的交換性有關。

cues.en: I'm going to talk about that more in a minute.
cues.zh: 等一下詳談。

cues.en: But first I want to show you a few examples.
cues.zh: 先看幾個例子。

cues.en: Here you see two functions of x f of x and g of x.
cues.zh: 兩個 x 的函數，f(x)、g(x)。

cues.en: These are distinct functions but of the same variable.
cues.zh: 不同函數，相同變數。

cues.en: And here you see the two options for compositions.
cues.zh: 兩種合成。

cues.en: So f of g of x and g of f of x.
Now I would like you to pause the video and solve these two.
cues.zh: 請暫停，解這兩個。

cues.en: So write out the formula for f of g of x and g of f of x.
cues.zh: 寫出兩者公式。

cues.en: Okay, did you figure it out yet?
cues.zh: 好，解出來了嗎？

cues.en: Here are the answers.
cues.zh: 答案在這裡。

cues.en: So f of g of x.
To compute f of g of x, we take the function f of x.
cues.zh: 計算時，先取 f(x)。

cues.en: And wherever you see an x in f of x, you replace it with the entirety of g of x.
cues.zh: 凡是看到 f 裡有 x，就用整個 g(x) 取代。

cues.en: So here we have two x squared minus four.
cues.zh: 這裡是 2x²−4。

cues.en: So we replace the entire x term with seven x plus three.
cues.zh: 把整個 x 換成 7x+3。

cues.en: So all of g of x gets into anywhere you see x.
cues.zh: g(x) 全部放進每個 x 的位置。

cues.en: Now in this case we only see x once.
cues.zh: 這裡 x 只出現一次。

cues.en: But for example if there was if this was minus four x then you would also put g of x over here as well.
cues.zh: 但如果這是 −4x，那這裡也要放 g(x)。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I'm not going to go through the rest of this algebra.
cues.zh: 其他代數不逐步講。

cues.en: But you can see my answer here.
cues.zh: 這裡能看到答案。

cues.en: So this is f of g of x.
cues.zh: 這是 f(g(x))。

cues.en: And now we have g of f of x.
cues.zh: 再來 g(f(x))。

cues.en: It's exactly the same concept.
cues.zh: 概念完全相同。

cues.en: We start by writing out g of x.
cues.zh: 先寫 g(x)。

cues.en: And anywhere we see an x in the definition of g of x, we plug in f of x into that x.
cues.zh: 定義裡每個 x，都代入 f(x)。

cues.en: So here we have seven of this thing x which is now f of x plus three.
cues.zh: 所以七乘這個 x，現在是 f(x)，再加三。

cues.en: And then yeah here it is worked out.
cues.zh: 這裡展開了。

cues.en: So you can see that g of x and f of x are different functions.
cues.zh: 所以 g(x)、f(x) 是不同函數。

cues.en: And this leads me back to the issue of Commutativity.
cues.zh: 回到交換性。

cues.en: First, a quick reminder of commutativity.
cues.zh: 先快速提醒。

cues.en: This term means that you can reverse the order of an operation and the result is the same.
cues.zh: 意思是顛倒運算順序，結果相同。

cues.en: And that's this case for addition and multiplication.
cues.zh: 加法、乘法如此。

cues.en: So for example three times four equals four times three and three plus four equals four plus three.
cues.zh: 例如三乘四等於四乘三，三加四等於四加三。

cues.en: Of course commutativity does not apply to subtraction because three minus four is not the same thing as four minus three.
cues.zh: 減法不適用，因為三減四不等於四減三。

cues.en: And the take home about composite functions is in general they do not conform to commutativity.
cues.zh: 合成函數的重點，是一般不滿足交換性。

cues.en: So that is to say that in general, f of g of x is not the same thing as g of f of x.
cues.zh: 一般而言，f(g(x)) 不等於 g(f(x))。

cues.en: Here you see an example from the two functions that I used earlier.
cues.zh: 這裡是前面兩函數的例子。

cues.en: I plugged in the number four for x, and you can see that f of g of x is different from g of f of x,
cues.zh: x 代四，可以看到兩個合成不同，

cues.en: even though it's the same two functions and X is taking on the same value.
cues.zh: 即使相同兩函數，x 也相同。

cues.en: Now, on the other hand, that doesn't mean that commutativity never holds.
cues.zh: 但不代表永遠沒有交換性。

cues.en: This statement actually is true for some particular pairs of functions.
cues.zh: 有些特定函數配對成立。

cues.en: So here's another example.
cues.zh: 再一例。

cues.en: I encourage you to pause the video and write out these two compositions to determine whether commutativity holds.
cues.zh: 鼓勵暫停，寫出兩種合成，判斷是否可交換。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: How did it go?
cues.zh: 如何？

cues.en: Well, curiously enough, you found that both of these functions, both of these compositions boil down to X.
cues.zh: 有趣，兩個合成最後都成 x。

cues.en: Now, there's a longer discussion to be had about the conditions on these two functions for commutativity to hold.
cues.zh: 這兩函數滿足交換性的條件，可以談更多。

cues.en: I don't want to get into that whole discussion.
cues.zh: 但不深入。

cues.en: It's not super relevant, and we actually will touch upon it with this particular type of example.
cues.zh: 不太相關，不過這類例子會再提。

cues.en: This is called an inverse function.
cues.zh: 叫反函數。

cues.en: So f and g are inverses of each other.
cues.zh: f、g 互為反函數。

cues.en: That's the topic of the next video.
cues.zh: 下支的主題。

cues.en: But the main take home here in this video is that commutativity of composed functions in general does not hold.
cues.zh: 但本支重點，是合成函數一般不滿足交換性。

cues.en: It does for some specific pairs of functions.
cues.zh: 某些特定配對才有。

cues.en: But basically you should assume that f of g of x is not the same thing as g of f of x.
cues.zh: 基本上應假設 f(g(x)) 和 g(f(x)) 不一樣。

cues.en: There are two notational forms to indicate a composite function, one of which I have already showed
cues.zh: 合成有兩種記號，一種已經，

cues.en: you, where one function is inside the other function, and the other notation looks like this.
cues.zh: 示範，把函數放進另一個；另一種這樣寫。

cues.en: With this little circle here in between these two functions.
cues.zh: 兩函數中間加小圓圈。

cues.en: Now I actually much prefer this notation.
cues.zh: 我其實更喜歡這種記法。

cues.en: I think this makes it crystal clear what is happening and in what order.
cues.zh: 覺得非常清楚呈現過程與順序。

cues.en: And I also like this because it's closer to the coding notation, where we embed one function as the input into another function.
cues.zh: 也因為更接近程式記法，把一個函數作為另一個的輸入。

cues.en: But anyway you will also see this notation sometimes.
cues.zh: 不過，有時也會看到這種。

cues.en: So it's good to have some familiarity here.
cues.zh: 所以稍微熟悉很好。

cues.en: Final point in this video you can compose any number of functions, not only two.
cues.zh: 最後，能合成任意多個函數，不只兩個。

cues.en: So here we see an example of a composite that comprises three functions.
cues.zh: 這例子由三個組成。

cues.en: And again note the order here.
cues.zh: 同樣注意順序。

cues.en: The functions that are applied earlier in the composition are inside more parentheses.
cues.zh: 越早套用的，放在越多層括號裡。

cues.en: So they are closer to the original variable x.
cues.zh: 所以更靠近原始 x。

cues.en: And by the way it's a good idea to think about the domains of these different functions.
cues.zh: 順帶，思考各函數定義域是好主意。

cues.en: So what are the domains of each individual function and what is the domain of the composed function.
cues.zh: 各自的定義域，以及合成後的定義域？

cues.en: I would like you to pause the video and think of your answer, or maybe write it down.
cues.zh: 請暫停思考，也許寫下來。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So the answers are that these two functions f and g have no restrictions on their domain.
cues.zh: 答案是，這兩個 f、g 沒有定義域限制。

cues.en: So all real valued x.
cues.zh: 所有實數 x。

cues.en: Or we can say that the domain goes from minus infinity to plus infinity.
cues.zh: 也就是負無窮到正無窮。

cues.en: But this function here g of x is it actually does have a restriction.
cues.zh: 但這裡 g(x) 確實有限制。

cues.en: Assuming that this is a real valued function, Zoom, then this function is limited to non-negative numbers.
cues.zh: 假設是實值函數，就只限非負數。

cues.en: So any number x that has a value of zero or any positive number okay.
cues.zh: x=0 或任何正數都可以。

cues.en: But does this domain restriction actually have any consequences for the domain of the composed function?
cues.zh: 這限制會影響合成函數的定義域嗎？

cues.en: And actually here the answer is no, because even when x is negative we're putting h inside g.
cues.zh: 其實不會，因為即使 x 負，也先把 h 放進 g。

cues.en: You can see that here.
cues.zh: 這裡看得到。

cues.en: So function h goes inside of function g.
cues.zh: h 放進 g。

cues.en: And even when x is negative it gets squared here.
cues.zh: 即使 x 負，也會在這裡平方。

cues.en: So in fact the input into g under the square root sign is always going to be a non-negative number.
cues.zh: 所以根號下、g 的輸入，永遠非負。

cues.en: Okey dokey.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's it.
cues.zh: 以上。

cues.en: For this video I introduced you to composite functions.
cues.zh: 這支介紹合成函數。

cues.en: Composite functions come up a lot in calculus.
cues.zh: 微積分經常用。

cues.en: For example, the chain rule for derivatives is the rule for how to compute derivatives of a composite function.
cues.zh: 例如導數的連鎖律，就是計算合成函數導數的法則。

cues.en: So you will see composite functions all over the place in the rest of calculus.
cues.zh: 所以微積分後面處處會看到。
